provider: Primary producer and publisher documentation; citation counts not yet queried
selection_note: Ten influential global dataset families outside the frozen top-50 GEE/community shared-paper selection. This is a bounded supplementary literature sample, not an exhaustive or universal ranking.
identity_method: Select a named producer dataset edition first, establish a dataset-specific primary paper DOI and coverage from producer/publisher sources, inspect canonical record overlap, then resolve the DOI to an OpenAlex work for a separate observed count. Keep data-release DOI separate from associated paper DOI and do not substitute broad algorithm/platform citations.

papers.dataset_family: WorldClim v2 global land climate surfaces
papers.product_edition: WorldClim v2.1 historical climate data, released 2020; 1970-2000 normals. v1 is a separate edition and has its own 2005 associated paper.
papers.spatial_coverage: Global land surfaces; resolutions from 30 arc-seconds to 10 arc-minutes. Land cells only; no claimed ocean coverage.

paper.title: WorldClim 2: new 1-km spatial resolution climate surfaces for global land areas
paper.edition_note: Paper describes WorldClim v2; producer's current v2.1 is a later data release within that product family.

existing_record_review.note: Existing WorldClim v1 canonical record is a distinct version/edition; do not merge v2.1 bytes into v1.

papers.dataset_family: CRU TS monthly high-resolution gridded multivariate climate dataset
papers.product_edition: CRU TS v4.10, current producer release observed 2026-10-31; global land time series 1901-2025. Paper describes the v4 family and initial v4.03 release; CRU TS v3.26 paper DOI 10.1002/joc.3711 is a distinct earlier edition and is not used for this count.
papers.spatial_coverage: Global land gridded monthly climate variables; station support varies spatially and some cells may use inserted climatology. Producer grids are 0.5 degree.

paper.title: Version 4 of the CRU TS monthly high-resolution gridded multivariate climate dataset
paper.edition_note: The 2020 paper documents CRU TS v4.03; v4.10 is a later continuation of the v4 family.

related_edition_papers.note: CRU TS v3 paper, a separate discontinued edition; not counted for the v4.10 candidate.

existing_record_review.note: No CRU TS canonical record identified in datasets/.

papers.product_edition: Current producer family page identifies CHELSA v2.1; the dataset paper is the 2017 foundational CHELSA climatology paper and describes the earlier 1979-2013 release. Keep edition distinction explicit.
papers.spatial_coverage: Land grid extent approximately 180W-180E and 90S-84N; 30 arc-seconds / about 1 km. Current family has multiple historical, present and projection products; no single time span implied for the family.

paper.title: Climatologies at high resolution for the earth’s land surface areas
paper.edition_note: Paper documents initial CHELSA climatologies v1; current v2.1 uses later inputs and should not be treated as identical data.

existing_record_review.note: No CHELSA canonical record identified in datasets/. WorldClim v1/v2 are distinct climate surfaces and are not identity matches.

papers.dataset_family: Global Precipitation Climatology Centre Full Data Monthly precipitation product
papers.product_edition: GPCC Full Data Monthly Product Version 2022, covering 1891-2020; product-specific DOI at 0.25-degree resolution. Other GPCC analysis products (Monitoring, First Guess, climatology and daily) are separate products.
papers.spatial_coverage: Gauge-based gridded precipitation over global land; Antarctica is not represented as a complete surface product. Resolutions are product variants; cited GPCC paper describes the broader GPCC family.

paper.title: A description of the global land-surface precipitation data products of the Global Precipitation Climatology Centre with sample applications including centennial (trend) analysis from 1901-present
paper.edition_note: Paper describes GPCC product family; it predates Full Data Monthly v2022.

existing_record_review.note: No GPCC canonical record identified in datasets/. CPC precipitation and CHIRPS records are different producers and products.

papers.dataset_family: EarthStat harvested area and yield maps for 175 crops circa 2000
papers.product_edition: Monfreda, Ramankutty and Foley 2008 crop-area, crop-yield, physiological-type and NPP maps; circa 2000 at 5 arc-minute resolution.
papers.spatial_coverage: Crop-specific gridded agricultural area and yield distributed over global croplands; thematic agricultural cells, not wall-to-wall land cover.

paper.title: Farming the planet: 2. Geographic distribution of crop areas, yields, physiological types, and net primary production in the year 2000
paper.edition_note: The paper describes the circa-2000 maps; later EarthStat crop products are separate releases.

existing_record_review.note: No EarthStat Monfreda crop-map canonical record identified in datasets/. Existing global cropland/irrigation records are not the same crop-area/yield layers.

papers.product_edition: GLiM v1.0; gridded derivative at 0.5-degree resolution with a companion harmonized global vector map.
papers.spatial_coverage: Global lithological classification of exposed continental surface geology; thematic mapping and source-map detail are heterogeneous, not a uniform geology survey.

paper.title: The new global lithological map database GLiM: A representation of rock properties at the Earth surface
paper.edition_note: Paper describes the GLiM v1 map database.

existing_record_review.note: No GLiM canonical record identified in datasets/.

papers.product_edition: ERA-Interim, 1979-August 2019; discontinued and superseded by ERA5. Keep separate from ERA5 (selected citation top-50 group 1).
papers.spatial_coverage: Global atmospheric reanalysis with related land, wave and surface products; ERA-Interim ended 2019-08-31. Candidate scope is the atmospheric reanalysis family, not each variable/level.

paper.title: The ERA-Interim reanalysis: configuration and performance of the data assimilation system
paper.edition_note: Exact paper is ERA-Interim-specific; do not substitute the ERA5 paper or counts.

existing_record_review.note: Existing ERA5 record is successor, not equivalent to ERA-Interim; keep separate and mark the legacy dataset archived.

papers.dataset_family: MODIS Terra/Aqua annual global land cover type MCD12Q1
papers.product_edition: Current producer product MCD12Q1 Collection 6.1 at 500 m annual resolution; primary associated paper describes Collection 5, so count is a base product-family proxy, not a v6.1 exact-release usage count.
papers.spatial_coverage: Annual thematic land-cover classifications for global land at 500 m, with multiple legends/classes; no ocean coverage claim.

paper.title: MODIS Collection 5 global land cover: Algorithm refinements and characterization of new datasets
paper.edition_note: Paper documents Collection 5; candidate product edition is Collection 6.1 and remains version-distinct.

existing_record_review.note: No MCD12Q1 canonical record identified in datasets/. Existing MODIS vegetation index, snow, and LST records are distinct products.

papers.dataset_family: History Database of the Global Environment (HYDE) 3.2
papers.product_edition: HYDE 3.2 historical population and land-use allocation maps, 10,000 BCE-2015 CE; version 3.2 paper is product-specific.
papers.spatial_coverage: Global historical population and land-use categories on approximately 5 arc-minute grids; modeled allocations, not observations at every cell.

paper.title: Anthropogenic land use estimates for the Holocene – HYDE 3.2
paper.edition_note: Paper and producer portal explicitly identify HYDE 3.2.

existing_record_review.note: No HYDE canonical record identified in datasets/. Related global urban/population records represent different models and epochs.

papers.dataset_family: FAO/University of Bonn Global Map of Irrigation Areas (GMIA) v5
papers.product_edition: GMIA v5, circa 2005 static map at 5 arc-minutes; v5 technical report is DOI 10.13140/2.1.2660.6728. The older peer-reviewed 2005 development paper describes the original GMIA family and is retained as a separate related paper, not silently substituted for the v5 report count.
papers.spatial_coverage: Area equipped for irrigation globally over land; reported grid extent -180,-60 to 180,90. Does not mean actual irrigated area for every cell; v5 also includes actual-irrigation and water-source percentage layers.

paper.title: Update of the Digital Global Map of Irrigation Areas to Version 5
paper.edition_note: FAO/Bonn report directly describes v5; it is a technical report DOI and may not resolve as a Crossref/OpenAlex work.

related_papers.title: Development and validation of the global map of irrigation areas
related_papers.note: Peer-reviewed paper for original map development; kept distinct from the direct v5 report identity.

existing_record_review.note: Existing record is a community global irrigation areas 2001-2015 product with a 2021 paper; GMIA v5 is circa-2005 area-equipped-for-irrigation and actual-use/water-source layers. Do not auto-merge.
